provenance.scope: Synthetic operands at historical Qwen, Mistral, Gemma dimensions; real execution is a separate stage.

shapes.memory_estimate_scope: Exact BF16 A/B plus FP32 C only; excludes padding, temporary buffers, compiler, executable, references and copies. This is not a peak allocation estimate.
shapes.padding_policy: Preserve logical M/K/N exactly. Kernel-required padding and trimming are measured by complete-call scope.
